property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, the reference C always reverts (transfer call fails) if any callee invocation reverts; the mutant can succeed silently when a callee reverts because it drops the require on the callee's returned bool.
change_summary: Require that the call to caddress may fail without reverting transfer by removing the require(_s) so failed external calls don't revert the whole transfer, changing observable outcome.
